chunks: 4981 - And ʿAmr ibn Abī al-Miqdām narrated from his father, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
It was among what Allah, the Exalted, revealed to Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام:

O Mūsā ibn ʿImrān, whoever commits adultery will have adultery committed against him, even if it be among his descendants after him. O Mūsā ibn ʿImrān, be chaste and your family will remain chaste. O Mūsā ibn ʿImrān, if you desire that the good of your household increase, then beware of adultery. O Mūsā ibn ʿImrān, as you deal, so shall you be dealt with.

key_terms.زُنِيَ بِهِ: adultery being committed against him as a recompense
key_terms.عِفَّ: maintain chastity and refrain from illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.كَمَا تَدِينُ تُدَانُ: as you act toward others, so you will be recompensed

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about zina, chastity, and how one’s actions affect one’s family?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a moral admonition revealed to Mūsā ibn ʿImrān عليه السلام concerning chastity and the consequences of zina. It teaches that personal moral conduct affects one’s family and descendants, and that a person is recompensed in accordance with his own actions.
